note: How each open-source tool would fit the pipeline demonstrated here. None of these tools is integrated with Sentinel X; the parsing, enrichment and correlation shown run in your browser over simulated data.

tools.name: Sysmon
tools.role: Windows endpoint telemetry: process creation, network connections, LSASS access, DNS queries, registry changes.

tools.name: Zeek
tools.role: Network security monitor that writes structured protocol logs (conn, dns, http, ssl) from packet capture.

tools.name: Suricata
tools.role: Signature-based IDS/IPS and network security monitoring engine producing alerts and EVE JSON logs.

tools.name: Wazuh
tools.role: Open-source XDR/SIEM: agents, decoders (parsing), rules (correlation) and alerting.

tools.name: Elastic Stack
tools.role: Ingest pipelines, the Elastic Common Schema (ECS) used for the field names on this page, search and dashboards.

tools.name: Security Onion
tools.role: Linux distribution bundling network and host monitoring, log management and case tools for threat hunting.

tools.name: Sigma
tools.role: Vendor-neutral detection rule format that converts to many SIEM query languages (used in Phase 6).
